title: Document native history locators and their complete detail response
outcome: The CLI agent guide and local work protocol describe native history detail locators, response shape, and return-window navigation accurately.
acceptance: docs/features/cli-agent-usage.md and docs/features/local-work-protocol.md state that native history events accept their bare record id or unique prefix through show --note.
The feature docs distinguish complete native transition reason or blocker text without a member field from inherited event/completion member responses.
The feature docs explain record-family navigation: history detail returns to --history while native, inherited, and shared note detail returns to --notes.
